bounded_positive_conclusion: Inspected direct-lineage primary sources do not supply the precise almost-sure empirical full-tensor unknown-density reflected fixed-positive-lag consistency theorem. A narrow consistency completion remains plausible.
required_attribution: Crommelin and Vanden-Eijnden 2006 already propose explicitly nonparametric general tensor spectral residual fitting; do not label this source merely parametric.
Crommelin and Vanden-Eijnden 2011 already supply drift/tensor spectral fitting and eigenvalue-power weighting.
Chen, Hansen and Scheinkman 2009 establish multivariate reversible identification/NPC foundations but assume known or consistently estimated matrix for their statistical sketch.
Gobet, Hoffmann and Reiss 2004 and Chorowski supply genuine scalar fixed-lag statistical spectral inference.

Nickl 2024, Giordano and Wang 2025, and Alberti, Barnes, Jambhale and Nickl 2025 establish multidimensional scalar fixed-lag inference; never claim that all multidimensional fixed-lag inference first becomes possible here.

Alberti, Barnes, Jambhale and Nickl 2025 Lemma 3.8 is a close cutoff-coordinate spectral excitation precursor, with earlier Alberti work credited there; the full-jet proof is a generalization of an established mechanism.
Ren, Lu, Ying and Rotskoff 2024 supply genuine tensor inference bounds but their actual theorem retains additive positive-lag bias.
